github.abstract:
Refuse black-box GEO scores. Put the evidence back in your hands. An open-source GEO research tool for AI visibility, reproducible testing, competitors and evidence. Enter a domain, compare model answers, inspect citations and repeat the same research later. Why pay $5,000+/year for a GEO SaaS dashboard? NiubiGEO is open source and self-hosted. Run it with your own model API keys, keep your research data in your environment and inspect the answer behind every observation. Model API, hosting and infrastructure costs are separate. Self-host · Official promotion platform · AI advisor Website · GitHub · 簡體中文 · UI: English, 簡體中文, Português (Brasil) · Quick start · 20 real cases · Releases · Packages · Docs Features · How to use it · Monitoring · Compare tools · Why NiubiGEO · Sponsors · Official services · FAQ You have built a product, written the docs and worked to get the word out. When people ask AI for tools, does your product make it into the answer? NiubiGEO is an open-source tool for tracking brand visibility and competitors in AI answers. Start with a domain to see how different models describe your product and which competitors they name. Then test keywords to find out who appears in the answers. Open any result to inspect the original response and returned sources. NiubiGEO Open-source AI visibility. Human-powered growth. Check it out on Product Hunt → Why NiubiGEO exists GEO tools can turn a complicated question into one unexplained number. NiubiGEO starts with the evidence instead: Question → AI model → Original answer → Mentions → Competitors → Citations → Historical run You can inspect the answer, the conditions, the sources and the next run. A visibility result without its underlying answer is difficult to investigate. Self-hosted research and data ownership Your keywords, competitor lists, positioning questions and research history may be commercially sensitive. Self-hosting lets you choose where the data is stored, who can access it and which model providers receive queries. It does not imply zero data exposure: external model APIs may receive the prompts you send to them. A project that keeps moving NiubiGEO began with one question: what does AI actually say about a product? The project now connects multi-model testing, natural discovery, source evidence, repeatable runs and keyword monitoring. The next step is to make changes between runs easier to see. Project status Stage Focus Status v0.1 AI visibility testing Shipped v0.2 Evidence and reproducibility Shipped v0.2.1 Multi-provider model connections Shipped v0.3 Keyword monitoring and structured research Released See the monitoring section and release history for verifiable updates. Current release · v0.3.3 Keyword history now supports UTC date/model filters, per-observation mention charts and CSV/JSON exports. Reports and measurement charts export their selected evidence. Repeated sampling also has a CLI with a request-count dry run. This release includes worker status, comparable Diff warnings, failed-model retries, tags and configured-alias fixes. Release notes · Read monitoring results · Ollama setup Previously shipped · v0.2.1 Connect through platform logos : 16 platform shortcuts open an API key form with the applicable endpoint prefilled. Mix model sources : choose OpenRouter, direct provider APIs and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints in the same test. Discover model IDs automatically or enter them manually. Keep results separate : answers, citations and failures retain their endpoint, model and search setting, even when model names match. Browse the full model catalog : filter by mainstream platform, source and search support. Custom search support is labeled unverified; structured analysis requires JSON Schema support. Connection guide · Download v0.3.3 · Docker installation v0.3 · Keyword Monitoring NEW / BETA v0.3 adds a separate Keyword Monitoring module in the workbench: define custom keywords, import batches, classify prompts as Discovery, Alternative, Comparison, Brand or Use case, start from AI Coding/SaaS/GEO/comparison templates, choose hourly/daily/weekly frequency, keep independent history, configure an optional brand and aliases, and compare snapshots in Diff View. English guide · 中文指南 . This release does not include a separate competitor detection dashboard. The current v0.3 scope is keyword monitoring, independent history and change comparison. What can you find out? How AI sees your product. What does it call your brand, and what does it think you do? Do different models agree? Who else appears. Which products does each model associate with yours? Do you or your competitors appear in keyword tests? Which words it associates with you. Compare the keywords models connect to your brand and other products to find differences worth investigating. Where the results come from. Inspect original answers, returned citations and changes across repeated tests. See the workbench: PostHog model answers and evidence links Read what each model actually said, then open the sources to check. An original screenshot from the September 8, 2026 study. Read the PostHog case . Get started Want to see it in action first? Explore 20 real cases . No installation or API key needed. To test your own product, you will need Node.js 22.13+ and your own OpenRouter API key: git clone --branch v0.3.3 --depth 1 https://github.com/Albert-Weasker/niubigeo.git cd niubigeo
npm ci
cp .env.example .env Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY in .env , then start the app: npm run server Open http://localhost:8787 to create your first project. Prefer a container? Follow the Docker guide . Existing users should read Backups and upgrades . How to use it Enter a domain. Create a project for your product. It is saved before you start testing. Choose your models. Search for and select one or more models, then set web search separately for each. Save your configuration and start a test. Models answer independently. If one fails, the other results remain available. Open the results. Review descriptions, competitors, keywords and sources. Open the original answer to check a finding. Keep observing. Confirm the keywords you want to test, then run keyword tests. Repeat measurements or set up scheduled monitoring to collect comparable records. Start with one model, then add more once you know what to look for. Reading the cases is free; testing your own project incurs model and search API charges. Talk to the video advisor The workbench shows a small advisor card by default. Click it to open the official advisor entry point , which redirects to the NiubiStar-hosted video advisor . You do not need to provide an API key to use the advisor. The local workbench loads no third-party script, iframe or video for this card, and the link does not include project data or model API keys. Choose which project details to share during your conversation on the external service. To hide the card, set NIUBIGEO_VIDEO_ADVISOR_ENABLED=false in .env and restart the server, or recreate the web container with docker compose up -d . 0 and off also hide it. Local diagnostics continue to work with the card disabled. This link adds no payment requirement and does not change the Apache-2.0 license. From one answer to ongoing observation What you want to do What NiubiGEO provides Manage several products Each domain has its own project, configuration, runs and evidence. Switch projects without mixing products into one report. Compare models Search, filter and select OpenRouter models. Inspect each model’s answer, result and errors, and retry a failed model separately. Choose whether to use web search Set each model to offline or its supported native search mode. Results retain the actual execution conditions. Understand brand and competitor descriptions Read business descriptions, categories, competing products and their associated keywords side by side.

It covers what most edits need: auto-captions, text-to-speech, background removal, keyframe animation, effects and titles, multi-track cutting, 4K export. With none of the catches: no watermark, no account, no subscription, no upload. Everything runs locally on a native Rust engine with a GPU compositor. Install it, drop in footage, cut. The AI models for captions, voices and cutout download once from Settings and work offline after that. Your footage never leaves your disk. Good for: TikTok, Reels and Shorts, YouTube videos, tutorials and screen recordings, podcast clips, memes. Also for machines: a built-in MCP server for AI agents ( concat --mcp , set up ) and a JSON-RPC API for scripts, so they can cut video with it too. Highlights 🚫 No watermarks. No account. No paywall. Ever. 🔒 100% local. Nothing uploads. Works offline. 💬 Auto-captions. Local Whisper. Pick a model size, get styled captions on the timeline. 🗣️ Text-to-speech + voice cloning. A free local voice on the desktop, or any voice from a few seconds of a recording. Phones are getting their own system voice. 🧍 Background removal. People, objects, or paint the mask yourself. 🎞️ Keyframes. Position, scale, rotation, opacity, volume, effect parameters. Curve editor built in. ✨ 100 effects, filters and transitions. GPU-rendered, live in the preview. ✂️ Cut fast. Split, trim, ripple, merge, freeze frame, speed. Magnetic timeline if you want it. 🎚️ Multi-track, multi-timeline. Overlays and picture-in-picture: stack video, stills and titles on as many tracks as you like. Several cuts in one project. Blend modes (screen, add, multiply…), crop, flips. 📝 Titles. Fonts, stroke, shadow, background plate. Presets to start from. 🎙️ One-switch voice cleanup. Denoise, enhance voice, level the loudness. Plus chipmunk, robot, telephone and friends. 📤 Export. H.264, HEVC, AV1. Up to 4K 60, 10-bit colour. 🦀 Native Rust engine. GPU compositor, proxies, hardware decode. 4K scrubs smoothly. 🤖 Scriptable. An MCP server built in, so Claude and other AI agents can edit with it ( one line to set up ), and a JSON-RPC API for scripts. A build from source adds gRPC and a command-line tool. 🖥️ macOS, Windows, Linux, Android. 26 languages. Same app, same project files. Download Two ways in: The website hands you the right build for your machine. Start here. GitHub Releases has every build for every platform, with installers, packages and checksums. For when you want to pick. Concat is in beta : it works, and it still has edges. Say so when you find one. Platforms ✅ Windows · x86_64 (ARM builds are paused, see #326 ). A setup and an .msi . If SmartScreen stops an unsigned build: More info › Run anyway ✅ macOS · Intel and Apple silicon. If macOS refuses to open an unsigned build: xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Concat.app ✅ Linux · x86_64 and ARM. .deb , .rpm , .AppImage and an Arch package. Build from source You need Rust 1.93 or newer (see rust-version in src/Cargo.toml ), the FFmpeg 7+ development libraries, cmake and a C++ compiler. macOS: brew install ffmpeg Windows: from FFmpeg's Windows downloads , take BtbN's win64-gpl-shared build (the one CI uses), unpack it and point FFMPEG_DIR at it Linux: use your distro's FFmpeg if it is version 7 or newer, otherwise use a BtbN shared build with FFMPEG_DIR like on Windows Then: cd src
cargo run -p concat # the editor window Other useful commands: cargo build --profile app -p concat # the shipping binary (fat LTO, stripped) cargo test # run the test suite cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings # what CI checks If you change text the interface shows, run python3 scripts/locales.py from the repo root so the string inventory stays in sync. github.title: poco-ai/Agentero
github.abstract:
為人與 Agent 協作而生的一站式科研工作臺 保留人類舒適的 PDF 閱讀習慣，為模型提供純淨的結構化上下文；文獻、筆記與互動記錄統一沉澱於本地。 中文 | English 如果本專案對你有幫助，請在右上角 給個 star 吧！ 背景與設計初衷 Zotero 是學術管理領域非常優秀的軟體。它功能成熟、生態穩定，幫助許多科研人員建立了最初的文獻歸檔體系。 但在當下日常科研與深度使用各類 Agent 時，傳統的文獻工具鏈暴露出一些斷點： 上下文嚴重分散 ：論文儲存在 Zotero，筆記記在 Obsidian，與模型的推導和分析留在各個網頁對話方塊中。三者資料彼此隔離，當需要 Agent 結合某篇具體論文與歷史筆記進行深入推導時，使用者必須反覆手動複製貼上。 文獻格式對模型不友好 ：人類習慣閱讀排版良好的 PDF 檔案；但對於模型而言，直接解析雙欄排版、跨頁表格、複雜數學公式和交叉引用的成本極高，極易產生識別錯誤與幻覺。結構化 Markdown 與 LaTeX 才是模型容易準確理解的格式。 維護成本較高 ：AI 伴讀、全文翻譯、筆記同步等高頻需求，往往需要安裝和除錯多個社群外掛，配置門檻高且在版本升級時容易出現相容性問題。 批次自動化能力有限 ：通過 Deep Research 或自動化檢索工具發現的大量文獻，目前仍需人工在瀏覽器中逐篇點選儲存，難以順暢銜接批次研究流。 Agentero 並非旨在替代 Zotero，而是探索一種人與 Agent 協同處理科研上下文的新方式 ： 人類負責 ：提出研究問題、進行學術價值判斷、深度研讀與核心結論推導； Agent 負責 ：批次檢索篩選、後設資料抓取、圖表與公式提取、引用關係梳理及基礎總結。 核心功能 1. 結構化閱讀與筆記系統 PDF 閱讀與批註 ：提供大綱導航、整頁與寬度自適應、平滑劃詞、高亮批註與全文檢索。 圖表與公式提取 ：自動解析論文中的數學公式、演算法虛擬碼及表格，生成結構化 Markdown 與 LaTeX 內容，確保 Agent 呼叫時上下文準確無誤。 雙向連結筆記 ：內建所見即所得 Markdown 編輯器，支援 [[雙鏈]] 引用語法、 / 快捷指令與 LaTeX 即時渲染，筆記與文獻建立原生關聯。 多模式翻譯服務 ：支援劃詞翻譯、按頁對照翻譯與全文翻譯，內建可用翻譯通道，並支援配置自定義 API Key（BYOK）。 分屏閱讀與分析：左側高亮批註，右側本地 Agent 基於準確的結構化上下文進行答疑與推導 劃詞翻譯與即時記錄：閱讀過程中提取的要點可直接沉澱至本地 Markdown 筆記 2. 開放的 Agent 協議與自動化介面 基於 ACP 協議連線本地 Agent ：底層遵循 Agent Client Protocol，支援連線各類本地執行的 Agent（如 Claude Code、OpenCode、Codex 或本地模型），不綁定特定廠商，上下文完全保留在本地。 內建 MCP (Model Context Protocol) ：可作為 MCP Server 執行，允許 ChatGPT Web、Claude Desktop 等外部客戶端直接檢索並呼叫本地文獻庫作為上下文。 極客 Kortix CompanyOS The open-source CompanyOS: the cloud-native agent harness for companies. Open Source  ·  Extensible  ·  Multiplayer  ·  Sovereign Always-on agents that start on events, run in parallel and share one memory of your company. Build custom agents on pi and ship them from one git repo. Schedules, webhooks, your tools' events
and your team's messages start them. My Kortix routes the work, and swarms of agents run it in
parallel, each on its own cloud computer with state that persists. Agents connect to 3,000+ apps, build and host the apps your company needs, and land every change
through a review your team approves. Share agents and context across your whole team.
Open source, any model, on your infrastructure or ours. Website · Guide · Cloud · AI Transformation · Manifesto A new kind of system An agent today is one chat session on one machine. It waits for a person to type. It blocks while a
long job runs. Every task it takes on shares one context. It stops when the laptop sleeps. A person
can follow only a few such sessions at once, so human attention runs out long before the model does. Kortix CompanyOS takes the session out of the person's hands. It is a cloud-native agent harness : you
write custom agents on pi, an open-source agent harness, and Kortix deploys them to the cloud and
supplies everything around the agent loop that one session cannot. Always on Compute and state are separate. Every session runs on its own cloud computer. The computer sleeps 15 to 20 minutes after the last turn and wakes on the next message or event, with its full history. State lives in the repo, in Drive, in the session's /workspace and in the session's record. Event-driven Triggers start agents from schedules, signed webhooks, connector events, App events and merged change requests. A filter in code drops noise before any model runs. A session subscribes to the events of its own work, and an agent sets its own check-in before it stops. One agent to talk to You talk to My Kortix . It answers at once, hands writing, research, code and app work to the agent made for it in a session of its own, and tells you the result. Nothing it hands off blocks the conversation. A follow-up goes to the same agent, with everything that agent already knows. Swarms A session hands work off in the background, runs a workflow that coordinates many agents, and messages other sessions. Every child reports back by itself. Thousands of agents run in parallel on one config. Long horizon When a context fills, the agent continues in a fresh one and searches the session's full record for the exact lines it needs. Nothing is summarized. A job outlives one turn and one context window. Scales out Compute is disposable and state persists, so capacity grows by adding computers, not by growing one. Each new session gets its own computer. A sleeping computer uses no compute. You, in the web app             Slack · Teams · email        Events

   What lands on main goes through a change request a person approves Connect your company's tools once, and every agent and every teammate works with them, with the
same skills and the same company memory. Your agents, skills, memory and connectors live in one
git repo you own : your whole company as code. Any model, your own keys, on Kortix Cloud, in your
VPC or on your own on-prem network. Kortix, end to end One system, from the message that starts the work to the change that lands it. Layer What it does Guide Reach People work from the web, desktop and mobile apps, the terminal, Slack, Microsoft Teams and email, and from other AI tools through MCP. All of them read the same projects and sessions. Everywhere Triggers Schedules, signed webhooks, connector events, App events and merged change requests start agents with nobody at the keyboard. A filter in code drops noise first. A loop wakes a session later, once or on repeat. Triggers My Kortix The one agent you talk to. It hands each task to the agent made for it, runs the work in the background and reports the result. The built-in agent Agents Custom pi agents: a prompt, a model, permissions, and the skills, tools, commands and pi extensions they may use. An agent proposes changes to its own skills, and a person approves them. Agents , Skills Swarms Background hand-offs, workflows that run many agents at once, and messages between sessions. Thousands of agents run in parallel on one config. Several agents at once Outcomes A goal with a definition of done. An agent works it, wake after wake, until a separate verifier session confirms it is done. Outcomes Computers Every session gets its own isolated cloud computer: a terminal, a browser, a desktop you can watch live, the tools its sandbox template installs. It sleeps when idle and wakes with its full history. Connect your own computer for work that must run on it. Computers Memory and state The git repo holds the company's agents, skills and rules. Drive holds shared folders and company memory. /workspace keeps a session's files. When a context fills, the agent searches the session's full record word for word. Drive Connectors 3,000+ apps, plus MCP, OpenAPI, GraphQL and raw HTTP. Allow, Ask or Block per tool. Credentials stay on the server and never enter the machine. Connectors Apps Agents build and host sites, internal tools and backends at a stable URL, behind Kortix sign-in. Always-on or on-demand machines, up to 20 per group, persistent volumes, snapshots, releases and rollback. Apps Models Kortix-managed models, your own provider keys, a ChatGPT subscription or a Claude subscription. Every request goes through the Kortix LLM gateway with budgets and access rules. Models Team and control Roles, groups and per-resource permissions. Change requests a person approves, approval rules, an audit log, SAML 2.0 SSO and SCIM 2.0, secrets encrypted with a key per project. Teams , Security Build on it The kortix CLI, the REST API, @kortix/sdk , its React hooks, @kortix/ui and generative UI. Developers Run it anywhere Kortix Cloud, your VPC or your own on-prem network, from the same images. Self-host What is a CompanyOS? An operating system is the layer everything on a computer runs on. A CompanyOS is that layer for
a company: the place its AI agents do the work, and the rules they work under. A computer's OS Kortix CompanyOS Shell My Kortix : the one agent you talk to. It routes the work.

已在「設定」配置並驗證生圖模型後，建立時可開啟「啟用生圖」，AI 會在真正需要視覺素材的位置按頁面內容和風格自動配圖；會增加一些生成耗時，關閉後仍可在編輯頁手動生圖。 生成後可預覽、演示，或在編輯頁繼續拖拽元素、插入圖片/影片、對話修改、回退歷史版本、生成演講稿；無論匯入還是新建的演示稿，都可匯出為接近 100% 還原的可編輯 PPTX。 🎨 內建 90+ 風格 Skill 想製作自己的風格 Skill，可以使用官方風格生成包： arcsin1/style-generate-skill 。它適合把參考設計、配色和排版要求整理成可匯入 Oh My PPT 的風格包。 🖼️ AI 生圖與智慧配圖 生圖能力分為兩個入口，分別適合整套生成和局部補圖： 使用場景 怎麼使用 結果 建立整套演示稿 在「設定 → 生圖模型」新增並 驗證 模型；建立頁勾選「啟用配圖生成」，選擇一個帶「支援生圖」標識的風格 AI 僅在合適的視覺位置自動生成插畫、背景或視覺元素，並保留文字安全區與風格一致性 編輯已有頁面 開啟編輯頁的生圖面板，參考當前頁內容生成提示詞或自行填寫，選擇模型和尺寸後生成 可預覽生成結果，插入畫布繼續排版，或直接設為當前頁背景 內建 Provider 包括即夢 3.0 / 4.0、Agnes AI、Seedream、矽基流動、Gemini 及 OpenAI 相容圖片介面；文本模型與生圖模型是兩套獨立配置。生圖配置需先在「設定 → 生圖模型」通過真實測試，驗證成功後才能儲存。 生成的圖片會歸檔到當前會話的本地素材目錄，可繼續編輯、替換、匯出或隨會話遷移；自動配圖不會改變頁面尺寸，也不會覆蓋手動上傳的圖片。生圖請求會發送到所選 Provider，請遵循其隱私與內容政策。 🔤 字型管理 內建 14 款精選 Google 字型（含中文字型），同時支援上傳本地 .woff2 字型檔案，可自定義字型名稱、分類（無襯線/襯線/手寫/等寬等）、用途（標題/正文）和語言型別（拉丁/CJK）。 建立演示稿時，可以分別指定 標題字型 和 正文字型 ，也可以交給 AI 根據演示主題和風格自動匹配最合適的字型組合。匯出 PPTX 時，已使用的字型會自動嵌入到檔案中，確保在其他電腦上開啟時字型顯示一致。 🎬 動畫支援 Oh My PPT 的頁面是 HTML 幻燈片，支援 16+ 種頁面切換動畫，並內建本地 Anime.js v4 動畫執行時。生成或編輯頁面時，可以讓 AI 為標題、資料卡片、圖片、圖表容器、步驟模組等整塊元素新增演示動畫。 除了由 AI 自動新增動畫，也可以在編輯模式中直接選中單個元素，為它設定入場、強調或退出效果，並調整自動播放或點選觸發、動畫時長和進入方向。 動畫更偏向真實演講場景：讓內容按講述節奏逐步出現，而不是一頁內容一次性全部鋪開。適合彙報、路演、課堂演示和產品講解。 目前支援這些常用表達： 淡入 ：模組出現時輕量過渡。 位移入場 ：從上、下、左、右短距離滑入，適合標題、卡片和列表。 縮放強調 ：關鍵數字或結論卡片輕微放大後回落。 錯峰展示 ：多張卡片或多條要點按順序依次出現。 點選逐條出現 ：演示時通過點選逐步展開內容，方便按講述節奏推進。 更推薦使用「整個元素」的動畫，而不是把文字拆成很多碎片逐字亂動。這樣畫面更穩、可讀性更好，也更適合匯出和二次編輯。動畫主要用於引導視線和表達層級，不建議做複雜時間線、高頻閃爍、無限迴圈或大幅抖動。 🦙 支援本地 Ollama 模型（OpenAI 相容） 專案支援通過 OpenAI 相容協議 接入本地 Ollama。 在「設定」頁面這樣填寫即可： provider : openai base_url : http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 model : 你本地拉取的模型名（例如 qwen2.5-coder:14b ），建議使用 14B+ 的模型（或雲端強模型） api_key : 任意非空字串（例如 ollama ） 說明： Ollama 預設不校驗 API Key，但應用側會做「非空」校驗，所以不能留空。 推薦使用 14B+ 的模型（或雲端強模型）接入生成。 OpenAI 官方端點不會攜帶非標準的 thinking 參數，避免返回 400 Unknown parameter ；配置其他 OpenAI 相容 base_url 時仍會請求關閉 thinking，避免工具呼叫等多輪鏈路丟失 reasoning_content 。 Ollama 配置用於文本生成、文件解析和編輯對話；需要生圖或自動配圖時，請在「設定 → 生圖模型」另行配置支援圖片生成的 Provider。 使用問題彙總 別忘了填寫模型配置 推薦：DeepSeek V4、Kimi、Doubao、Qwen、GLM、MiMo、MiniMax 等國產模型，以及 GPT、Claude 等國外模型。 在「設定 → 文本模型」頁面填寫用於創作、解析和編輯的模型配置，否則無法生成演示稿。 若要使用 AI 生圖或自動配圖，再到「設定 → 生圖模型」新增對應 Provider 的完整 JSON 配置並點選「驗證」。驗證會實際生成一張測試圖片；驗證成功後才能儲存該生圖模型，隨後即可在建立頁和編輯頁中選擇使用。 關於預覽模式 支援鍵盤左右鍵切換頁面；支援演示模式和全屏演示模式，按 ESC 退出演示。 關於匯出 目前支援五種匯出方式，另可將 HTML 演示稿打包為獨立開啟的檔案： PDF ：適合直接分享、歸檔和列印。 PNG ：一鍵批次匯出所有頁面圖片，適合插入文件、Notion、公眾號或社媒內容。 PNG 長圖 ：將整套頁面縱向拼接成一張長圖，適合發社媒、聊天分享、長文件預覽和移動端閱讀。 可編輯 PPTX ：純自研匯出底層，常規場景還原度接近 100%，可在 PowerPoint / Keynote 中繼續編輯。 MP4 ：匯出為影片檔案，適合釋出到社媒、傳送給客戶或在不方便播放 PPT 的場景中使用。 HTML 打包檔案 ：將演示稿和執行資源打包，雙擊即可在瀏覽器中開啟預覽和演示。 📦 未簽名應用打不開的問題 目前釋出包可能還沒有進行系統級程式碼簽名，所以 macOS 或 Windows 第一次開啟時可能會出現安全提示。這個提示通常不是應用損壞，而是系統對「未簽名/未公證應用」的預設攔截。 macOS 如果 macOS 提示「無法開啟」「已損壞」「無法驗證開發者」，可以按下面任意一種方式處理。 方式一：右鍵開啟 開啟「訪達」或「應用程式」資料夾。 找到 OhMyPPT.app 。 右鍵點選應用，選擇「開啟」。 在彈窗裡再次點選「開啟」。 這種方式通常只需要做一次，之後就可以正常雙擊開啟。 方式二：清除隔離屬性 如果右鍵開啟仍然不行，可以在終端執行： xattr -cr /Applications/OhMyPPT.app 然後重新開啟應用。 如果你把應用放在了其他目錄，請把命令裡的路徑替換成實際路徑，例如： xattr -cr ~ /Downloads/OhMyPPT.app Windows Windows 可能會因為安裝包未簽名而觸發 SmartScreen 提示，例如「Windows 已保護你的電腦」。這是未簽名應用常見的系統提示。 處理方式： 在提示視窗點選「更多資訊」。 確認應用名稱是 OhMyPPT 。 點選「仍要執行」。 github.abstract:
SPONSORED BY Orbit . Free, open-source macOS screen recorder, screenshot tool and video editor: auto-zoom, smooth cursor, backgrounds, web recordings and AI agent recording. Open OpenStock · Changelog · Self-host it · Sponsor · Discord OpenStock Markets, minus the paywall. OpenStock is a free, open-source alternative to expensive market platforms: track prices, watch the whole market and dig into company insights. Use it at openstock-ods.vercel.app , or run your own copy with every feature. ❤️ 13,000+ people use OpenStock for free. Help keep it that way: sponsor from $5 a month , or read how OpenStock is funded . Note OpenStock is community-built and not a brokerage. Market data may be delayed depending on the provider and your setup. Nothing here is financial advice. 📋 Table of Contents 🔋 Features ⏱️ How fresh is the data ⚙️ Tech stack 🤸 Quick start 🔐 Environment variables 🐳 Self-hosting : Docker, prebuilt image, one-click deploys, Vercel 🧱 Project structure 📡 How it works 🌍 Market support 🧪 Scripts and tests 🤝 Contributing 🏆 Contributors 🛡️ Security 📜 License 🌱 Open Dev Society manifesto 🙏 Acknowledgements ❤️ Sponsor OpenStock 🔋 Features Markets A dashboard for eight markets: US, India, Germany, Canada, Australia, Saudi Arabia, Crypto and Forex, with an index pulse, a sector heatmap, market leaders and top stories. Search every exchange Finnhub covers with ⌘K , and keep stocks open as browser-style tabs. Stock pages TradingView candles with drawing tools (trend lines, Fibonacci, shapes, text) and fullscreen. Pick indicators once (SMA, EMA, Bollinger Bands, VWAP, RSI, MACD, Stochastic, ATR) and they stay on every chart. Financials, technicals and the company profile. Sentiment from Reddit, X, news and Polymarket (with an Adanos key). Watchlist and alerts A watchlist of up to 50 stocks, saved to your account. Price alerts above or below a target, checked every 5 minutes and emailed to you (in realtime mode). A weekly, AI-written news digest by email every Monday. Accounts Email and password, plus Google and GitHub sign-in when configured; password reset and a profile page. Rate-limited sign-in, sign-up and password reset; resetting your password signs out your other devices. Community A changelog that credits everyone who contributed, a Wall of love , and an update banner in the app. ⏱️ How fresh is the data Charts always stream live from TradingView. Quotes, watchlist prices and alerts come from Finnhub: Quotes Price alerts Cost Community : openstock-ods.vercel.app Every hour, shared by everyone No Free OpenStock Cloud (coming soon) Every 15 seconds By email $5 a month Self-hosted Every hour, or every 15 seconds with NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE=realtime and your own Finnhub keys By email, in realtime mode Free ⚙️ Tech stack App Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui and Radix Accounts and data Better Auth, MongoDB with Mongoose Market data Finnhub, TradingView widgets, Adanos (sentiment) Background jobs Inngest Email Nodemailer (Gmail), Kit for the newsletter AI Gemini, MiniMax or Siray Hosting Vercel; a Docker image on GitHub Container Registry for self-hosting 🤸 Quick start You need Node.js 22 LTS, a MongoDB database (a free Atlas cluster, or the Docker setup ) and a free Finnhub key. git clone https://github.com/Open-Dev-Society/OpenStock.git cd OpenStock
npm ci
cp .env.example .env # fill in MONGODB_URI, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET and FINNHUB_API_KEY node scripts/check-env.mjs # checks your .env npm run test:db # checks the MongoDB connection npm run dev # http://localhost:3000 Welcome emails, price alerts and the weekly digest run as Inngest jobs. Locally, start Inngest's dev server alongside the app: npx inngest-cli@latest dev . For production: npm run build && npm start . 🔐 Environment variables Every variable is listed with comments in .env.example . The ones that matter: Variable Needed What it's for MONGODB_URI Yes Your MongoDB database BETTER_AUTH_SECRET Yes Signs sessions. Generate it with openssl rand -hex 32 . Auth refuses to run in production without it BETTER_AUTH_URL Yes The app's public URL, used for auth callbacks and links in emails FINNHUB_API_KEY Yes Market data. Or put several free keys, comma-separated, in FINNHUB_API_KEYS : they're rotated, and each adds 60 requests a minute NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE No cached (hourly, the default) or realtime (every 15 seconds, with price alerts). Fixed when the app is built: rebuild after changing it INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY , INNGEST_EVENT_KEY In production Background jobs: welcome emails, price alerts and the weekly digest NODEMAILER_EMAIL , NODEMAILER_PASSWORD No Sending email through Gmail, with an app password. Without them, emails are skipped GEMINI_API_KEY (or MiniMax or Siray) No AI-written welcome emails and the news digest ADANOS_API_KEY No The sentiment card on stock pages KIT_API_KEY , KIT_API_SECRET , KIT_WELCOME_FORM_ID No The weekly digest newsletter in Kit GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / _SECRET , GITHUB_CLIENT_ID / _SECRET No Social sign-in. Callbacks: <BETTER_AUTH_URL>/api/auth/callback/google and /github NEXT_PUBLIC_FINNHUB_API_KEY still works as a name for the Finnhub key. No key is ever sent to the browser. 🐳 Self-hosting Docker Compose Runs OpenStock and MongoDB together. MongoDB is only reachable inside the Docker network; it isn't published on your machine. Fill in .env (see above). For the bundled database, choose a password and use it in both places. Letters and digits are simplest; @ : / ? # must be percent-encoded in the URI. MONGO_ROOT_PASSWORD = change-me MONGODB_URI = mongodb://root:change-me@mongodb:27017/openstock?authSource=admin Start it: docker compose up -d --build Open http://localhost:3000 The image build needs no secrets: every variable is read when the container starts, except NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE , which Compose passes to the build from .env . Data lives in the mongo-data volume, and the MongoDB password is only applied when that volume is first created. Prebuilt image Every push to main publishes ghcr.io/open-dev-society/openstock for amd64 and arm64, tagged latest , sha-<commit> , and a version for each release (for example 2026.10.18 ). To use it, replace build: under openstock in docker-compose.yml with: image : ghcr.io/open-dev-society/openstock:latest then run docker compose pull && docker compose up -d . The prebuilt image runs in cached mode; build it yourself for realtime. One-click deploys Railway OpenStock ships a railway.json that builds the Dockerfile , checks health on /sign-in and restarts on failure. The template above sets everything up; to do it by hand: Create a project and add a MongoDB database ( + New → Database → MongoDB ). Add a service from this repository ( + New → GitHub Repo ). In the service's Variables , set: MONGODB_URI = ${ {MongoDB.MONGO_URL } } BETTER_AUTH_SECRET = ${ {secret(32) } } BETTER_AUTH_URL = https:// ${ {RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN } } FINNHUB_API_KEY = your_finnhub_key GEMINI_API_KEY = your_gemini_api_key INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY = your_inngest_signing_key INNGEST_EVENT_KEY = your_inngest_event_key NODEMAILER_EMAIL = youraddress@gmail.com NODEMAILER_PASSWORD = your_gmail_app_password Under Settings → Networking , generate a public domain and redeploy. For background jobs, add your Railway domain as an app in the Inngest dashboard , pointing to https://<your-domain>/api/inngest . To turn on realtime mode, also set NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE=realtime ; Railway passes it to the build. Vercel Import the repository, set the variables above for Production, and connect Inngest (its Vercel integration sets both keys). vercel.json pins functions to Mumbai ( bom1 ), next to the hosted database; change it to the region nearest yours.

github.title: SWE-agent/mini-swe-agent
github.abstract:
The minimal AI software engineering agent 📣 mini-swe-agent now powers Ramp SWE-Bench 📣 mini-swe-agent beats Claude Code and Codex on DeepSWE 📣 Run mini-swe-agent on our new & extremely challenging benchmark, ProgramBench 📣 New tutorial on building minimal AI agents Warning This is mini-swe-agent v2 . Read the migration guide . For the previous version, check out the v1 branch . In 2024, we built SWE-bench & SWE-agent and helped kickstart the coding agent revolution. We now ask: What if our agent was 100x simpler, and still worked nearly as well? mini is Widely adopted : Used by Meta, NVIDIA, Essential AI, IBM, Nebius, Anyscale, Princeton University, Stanford University, and many more. Minimal : Just some 100 lines of python for the agent class (and a bit more for the environment , model , and run script ) — no fancy dependencies! Performant: Scores >74% on the SWE-bench verified benchmark ; starts much faster than Claude Code Deployable: Supports local environments , docker/podman , singularity/apptainer , bublewrap , contree , and more Compatible: Supports all models via litellm , openrouter , portkey , and more. Support for /completion and /response endpoints, interleaved thinking etc. Built by the Princeton & Stanford team behind SWE-bench , SWE-agent , and more Tested: More motivation (for research) SWE-agent jump-started the development of AI agents in 2024. Back then, we placed a lot of emphasis on tools and special interfaces for the agent.
However, one year later, as LMs have become more capable, a lot of this is not needed at all to build a useful agent!
In fact, the mini agent Does not have any tools other than bash — it doesn't even need to use the tool-calling interface of the LMs.
This means that you can run it with literally any model. When running in sandboxed environments you also don't need to take care
of installing a single package — all it needs is bash. Has a completely linear history — every step of the agent just appends to the messages and that's it.
So there's no difference between the trajectory and the messages that you pass on to the LM.

github.abstract: All-in-one AI framework txtai is an all-in-one AI framework for semantic search, LLM orchestration and language model workflows. The key component of txtai is an embeddings database, which is a union of vector indexes (sparse and dense), graph networks and relational databases. This foundation enables vector search and/or serves as a powerful knowledge source for large language model (LLM) applications. Build autonomous agents, retrieval augmented generation (RAG) processes, multi-model workflows and more. Summary of txtai features: 🔎 Vector search with SQL, object storage, topic modeling, graph analysis and multimodal indexing 📄 Create embeddings for text, documents, audio, images and video 💡 Pipelines powered by language models that run LLM prompts, question-answering, labeling, transcription, translation, summarization and more ↪️️ Workflows to join pipelines together and aggregate business logic. txtai processes can be simple microservices or multi-model workflows. 🤖 Agents that intelligently connect embeddings, pipelines, workflows and other agents together to autonomously solve complex problems ⚙️ Web and Model Context Protocol (MCP) APIs. Bindings available for JavaScript , Java , Rust and Go . 🔋 Batteries included with defaults to get up and running fast ☁️ Run local or scale out with container orchestration txtai is built with Python 3.11+, Hugging Face Transformers , Sentence Transformers and FastAPI . txtai is open-source under an Apache 2.0 license. Note NeuML is the company behind txtai and we provide AI consulting services around our stack. Schedule a meeting or send a message to learn more. We're also building an easy and secure way to run hosted txtai applications with txtai.cloud . Why txtai? New vector databases, LLM frameworks and everything in between are sprouting up daily. Why build with txtai? Up and running in minutes with pip or Docker # Get started in a couple lines import txtai embeddings = txtai . Embeddings () embeddings . index ([ "Correct" , "Not what we hoped" ]) embeddings . search ( "positive" , 1 ) #[(0, 0.29862046241760254)] Built-in API makes it easy to develop applications using your programming language of choice # app.yml embeddings : path : sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 CONFIG=app.yml uvicorn " txtai.api:app " curl -X GET " http://localhost:8000/search?query=positive " Run local - no need to ship data off to disparate remote services Work with micromodels all the way up to large language models (LLMs) Low footprint - install additional dependencies and scale up when needed Learn by example - notebooks cover all available functionality Use Cases The following sections introduce common txtai use cases. A comprehensive set of over 70 example notebooks and applications are also available. Semantic Search Build semantic/similarity/vector/neural search applications. Traditional search systems use keywords to find data. Semantic search has an understanding of natural language and identifies results that have the same meaning, not necessarily the same keywords. Get started with the following examples. See below to learn more. This supports all LLMs txtai supports (Hugging Face, llama.cpp, OpenAI / Claude / AWS Bedrock via LiteLLM). Agent prompting with agents.md and skill.md are also supported. RAG is commonly used to "chat with your data". Check out this RAG Quickstart Example . Additional examples are listed below. This includes models for extractive question-answering, automatic summarization, text-to-speech, transcription and translation. Check out this Workflow Quickstart Example . English · 中文 Built to keep going. OpenBitFun is a highly customizable, open-source agent workspace that keeps work moving your way. Four powerful Agent Harness modes · Cross-device remote control · Customization from Mini Apps to source If this is the kind of agent workspace you want, ⭐ Star OpenBitFun and help more people discover it. Download Desktop · Mobile Releases · Mini App Marketplace · Join the community · Contribute demo.mp4 Four modes for the way you work The Agent Harness shapes how a task gets done. It plans steps, manages context, calls tools, coordinates agents, and brings their results together. Choose the mode that fits the task: Mode When to use it Minimal Quick collaboration. Start with a clear goal. The agent acts directly, you give feedback, and you refine the work together. Standard Everyday tasks. For work with several steps: plan the approach, work through it, and check the results. Ultimate Complex tasks. Dig into demanding problems, divide the work among agents, and bring their results together. Creative Creation and customization. Build Mini Apps or extend OpenBitFun's interface and capabilities to make the workspace your own. Switch computers. Control from your phone. Switch the device, switch the entire workspace. Choose another connected computer in the desktop app, and the interface switches to that device's sessions, workspaces, files, and task status. Move between your home computer, office computer, and server from the same app. Your phone is a remote controller. Send instructions, check progress, and respond to approval requests from your phone or browser. Tasks run on the selected host and keep going when you switch views or disconnect the controller. The official Relay is ready to use; no server deployment is required. Sign in on your devices with the same OpenBitFun account, using GitHub or an email verification code where supported. Same-network connections are also available. See the connection FAQ for login, internet access, and self-hosting requirements. On mobile, switch between layouts for one, two, or three screens. Focus on the conversation with a single screen, then unfold your phone to view conversations and files side by side. The interface adapts as the screen layout changes. Connection and deployment details Use SSH to work on a remote host, through a jump host, or inside a container. File access, terminals, and workspace commands target that environment; the Agent Runtime stays on the OpenBitFun host. The desktop app and CLI share core execution capabilities; mobile clients and messaging bots offer more ways to control tasks. Same-account device control uses the official Relay by default. Desktop can also run a local Relay for same-network mobile control. Both paths use the online OpenBitFun identity service for sign-in; LAN mode is not an offline-login option. A private Relay requires a matching client build: see the deployment guide . Device-to-device payloads are encrypted end to end with keys generated on the devices. Sessions and files are read from the owning online device on demand; the Relay still handles account, device, and routing metadata. This does not cover traffic to model providers, messaging bots, or published Pages. See the privacy boundaries , Remote Connect , and remote workspaces . Turn everyday needs into useful apps Build a Git insights panel for a repository, a workspace for presentations, or a form that brings routine actions together. Mini Apps turn specific needs into tools you can use. Describe what you need and let the agent build it. Each Mini App pairs a dedicated interface with an agent conversation, so you can use the app for everyday work and keep improving it through chat. Install and reuse the apps you build, or explore the Mini App Marketplace for tools that fit your work. Extend OpenBitFun with OpenBitFun Customize the roles, tools, interface, and source code. Start with an agent that fits your work, then extend the workspace around it: Build a specialist agent. Choose a model, define its role, and equip it with the tools and workflows it needs for motion comic production, visual design, code review, or your own field. Connect tools and workflows. Connect tools through MCP, turn repeatable processes into Skills, and use Hooks to customize how tasks run. Change the interface and source. Install skins for a new look, or modify the UI, tools, and runtime source to build your own version of OpenBitFun. You can ask OpenBitFun's Code Agent to modify and extend OpenBitFun itself. Learn more about agent management , Hooks and compatibility , and the product architecture . Built for sustained work The Rust Agent Runtime manages session state, context, and tool execution. Persistent sessions, interruption recovery, long-term memory, and support for extended tasks help keep work moving. Context compression and cache reuse help control resource consumption over longer runs. In this DeepSWE v1.1 evaluation, OpenBitFun achieved: GLM-5.3-Flash : 64.6% pass rate, 42.9 minutes median runtime (P50). DeepSeek-V4-Flash : 56.6% pass rate, 19.6 minutes median runtime (P50). More to explore These are just some of OpenBitFun's features. Explore more tools, workflows, and extensions as you put it to work on your own tasks. Where we're headed OpenBitFun is still evolving. Here are three directions we want to explore: Lights-Out Factory : Plan and design during the day, let tasks continue on a server, and come back the next morning to review the results. Infinite Radius : Extend from desktops and phones to wearables and embedded devices, so work can continue in more places. App Evolution : Enable more people to shape software, from personal tools to versions tailored to a profession or industry. Getting there means making long-running tasks more reliable, the runtime more efficient, and the desktop experience smoother. Build with it. Help shape it. Share what you build, offer feedback, or contribute code to help shape OpenBitFun. Share your use cases and experience, contribute agents, Skills, Mini Apps, or skins, or help improve the docs, interface, and runtime. Ideas and questions are welcome in this repository's Issues and Discussions. See the contribution guide for the development workflow. Download, setup, and running from source Get the Windows, macOS, or Linux package from the official download page . Install it, configure a model, and open a workspace to get started. See the user guide for usage instructions and download verification for package signature checks. Migration note: OpenBitFun 1.0.0 is not data-compatible with legacy 0.2.x releases. To migrate legacy data,
use the OpenBitFun Data Tools , currently available
for stable releases 0.2.17–0.2.19. To run from source, install Node.js 22.12+, pnpm 10.15.0, the Rust toolchain , and the Tauri prerequisites . Clone the repository, then run: pnpm install
pnpm run desktop:dev Desktop development supports frontend hot reload and automatic Rust rebuilds. See the CLI guide for the command-line workflow. Core code is licensed under the MIT License . others.title: Risks of omission and commission errors when using generative AI in behavioral science research.
others.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is rapidly being adopted across the behavioral sciences, reshaping how researchers generate ideas, design studies, collect data, and analyze results. While GenAI offers substantial benefits such as increasing productivity, enabling more sophisticated methods, and lowering technical barriers, these gains come with potential costs in the form of errors. This article discusses the risks of errors as a foundation to decide when and how to use GenAI in behavioral research. We distinguish between two types of errors of shifting relative threat, depending on how narrowly a research task is specified. Open-ended tasks (e.g., ideation, literature review) leave a large space of plausible outputs and make researchers relatively more liable to errors of omission. In constrained, well-specified tasks (e.g., running a specified analysis, writing code to a stated scheme), the narrow solution space limits the scope for omission, raising the relative threat of errors of commission. We argue that commission errors are potentially easier to detect. Omission errors, by contrast, are harder to detect and pose greater risks to the diversity and scope of scientific inquiry. We propose that GenAI usage should be guided by a comparative assessment of error detectability. We offer practical recommendations for evaluating GenAI applications and for preserving the methodological diversity that sustains cumulative science.
